scene_objective: Luke assigns Ben the Outer Rim survey — the institutional cover for a disturbance father and son have been reading independently. Both feel the wrongness; only Ben carries the years of exposure that tell him what kind of trouble it is.
opening_mode: Luke's datapad shows a string of survey reports flagged with the same anomaly — Force readings that do not match any known phenomenon

key_beats.beat_description: Luke slides the datapad across the desk showing seventeen flagged survey reports
Ben scrolls through the anomaly data, zooming on three readings that match his own perception
Ben sets the datapad down and moves to the window — body language of someone accepting a solo mission

turning_point.trigger: Luke sets the datapad down and says, evenly, that he has felt something too. Ben hears the difference — his father is describing an anomaly; Ben is recognising a register he has lived inside since he
turning_point.shift: Luke sets the datapad down and says, evenly, that he has felt something too. Ben hears the difference — his father is describing an anomaly; Ben is recognising a register he has lived inside since he

closing_beat: Ben accepts the mission without suggesting a partner. Luke does not push. Neither of them acknowledges what that choice means.

emotional_arc.shift: Guarded attentiveness -> brief connection with Luke -> deliberate distance
